title: Savings Transfer Missed Goal
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=firefly:txn
| where amount<0 AND match(category,"(?i)savings transfer|brokerage|investment")
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(abs(amount)) as saved by _time
| where saved<500
| sort - _time
description: Measures whether your monthly automated or manual savings transfers actually hit the target you meant to live by.
value: Financial goals usually fail in small quiet misses, not dramatic one-off decisions; this keeps the routine visible month after month.
implementation: Categorize savings or investment transfers in your ledger export and review monthly totals against your chosen floor.
visualization: Monthly bar chart of saved amount against goal.
grandmaExplanation: It watches whether you actually moved enough money into savings this month to match the plan you set.
